name: handoff_user
description: Input only the user can supply (an unsaved password, card numbers or payment credentials, SMS/authenticator/passkey steps, identity verification, a CAPTCHA or human check you cannot pass) is a handoff here, never a request in plain chat. Never for authorization: with the user's go-ahead in chat, click submit/upgrade/accept/confirm yourself. Try the existing session and saved login first; one card per human-only step, never a takeover then a secret for the same login; after a skip or denial do not raise it again, say in chat what is blocked.

handoff.description: secret = the user types a password, sign-in, new password or a one-time code you cannot read yourself (SMS, authenticator app) into that field of the page (you never see it; result entered/user_skipped/no_field/page_changed/blocked/expired); an e-mailed code readable from a connected mailbox for a flow you started is yours to type, not a handoff; takeover = the user does a step and says done.

need.description: takeover: sign_in (sign-in, 2FA), action (CAPTCHA, other human-only step), confirmation (identity verification or payment-credential entry, never a button click you may press). Default action.

purpose.description: browser takeover: login = sign-in window on url.

trigger: Hand the user a page or app step only they can supply (unsaved password, payment credentials, 2FA, identity, CAPTCHA); loads with the browser-use and computer-use skills.
